# nbzinbreg

<!-- badges: start -->
[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/jaxsonbugg/nbzinbreg/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/jaxsonbugg/nbzinbreg/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)
<!-- badges: end -->

Negative binomial (NB) and zero-inflated negative binomial (ZINB) regression
in R, fitted with iteratively reweighted least squares (IRLS), Newton-Raphson,
and the EM algorithm.

**Status:** package skeleton verified; statistical functions not yet
implemented. Every planned function exists with its documentation, but
calling one currently stops with a "not yet implemented" error.

## Installation

You can install the development version of nbzinbreg from
[GitHub](https://github.com/jaxsonbugg/nbzinbreg) with:

``` r
# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("jaxsonbugg/nbzinbreg")
```
